name: arena-products
description: Public repository of Arena products. A product is a game (scored, deterministic, pays credits) or a world (unscored, runs in the visitor's browser). Authors submit either here; the Arena backend pulls the built, content-hash-pinned artifacts.

pnpm.//: Allowlist for install lifecycle scripts. A submission PR may freely edit games/<slug>/package.json and worlds/<slug>/package.json — path-guard stops infra edits, not dependency edits — and CI falls back to a non-frozen install when a new workspace member makes the lockfile stale. Without this, naming a dependency would run its postinstall in the runner before any gate has looked at the submission. esbuild is here because it fetches its own platform binary; nothing else in this repo needs a script.

//scripts: Product-level commands first — they take a slug of either kind. The kind-specific ones below still work and are what the product-level ones dispatch to; they are kept so a doc, a habit or an in-flight PR that names them does not break. `build:bundles` keeps its name because .github/workflows/publish.yml path-filters scripts/build-bundles.ts and the main Arena repo's README pins the command.
